message.content: {"General": "A bright, whimsical outdoor scene featuring a winding dirt path through a grassy field dotted with colorful flowers. The background includes floating islands topped with small houses and trees, a tall red-and-white striped tower, and a clear blue sky with fluffy clouds and twinkling stars. The overall style is cartoonish with soft shading and vibrant colors, evoking a magical, storybook atmosphere.", "Character 1": "A large anthropomorphic figure with a round face, big blue eyes, and rosy cheeks. The character wears a tall, red-and-white striped top hat and has a small orange triangular nose. The face is framed by short, curly brown hair. The character smiles gently and looks off to the side, exuding a friendly and curious demeanor. A small yellow bird perches calmly on the brim of the hat, adding a natural touch to the scene."}
